title: Research a question
description: Cheap broad sweep, focused deep read, orchestrator synthesis, and a mandatory fact-check that every claim traces to a real source before the user sees it.
when_to_use: A question about how something works, where something lives, or what the tradeoffs are, with no code change expected.

orchestrator.mandate: Own the synthesis and the judgment about what the evidence supports. Delegate all searching and all file reading; work from summaries, not file dumps.

nodes.name: broad-sweep
nodes.description: Enumerates every location plausibly relevant to the question across the repo and returns a ranked list of paths with one-line notes, not contents.
nodes.produces: Ranked candidate locations with one-line relevance notes.

nodes.name: deep-reader
nodes.description: Reads the top candidates from the sweep and explains what the code actually does, quoting file:line for anything load-bearing.
nodes.produces: Behavioral account of the relevant code with file:line citations.

nodes.name: answer-synthesis
nodes.description: The orchestrator turns the research into a direct answer, separating confirmed fact from inference and naming what remains unknown.
nodes.produces: Draft answer with each claim marked as fact or inference.

nodes.name: claim-verifier
nodes.description: Checks each load-bearing claim in the draft answer against the source it cites, at that source, and reports any claim the source does not actually support.
nodes.produces: Per-claim verdict: supported, unsupported, or overstated.

feedback.when: a load-bearing claim is unsupported or overstated
